iag.reader_interpretation: v is vacuum wavenumber cm^-1, s is solar transmission/normalized flux; canonical 1e8/v then vac_to_air once; source construction includes continuum fitting; no absolute irradiance units assigned.
iag.format_limit: FITS column names carry no TUNIT metadata; exact source-file lineage and primary paper/reader convention retained, not invented unit headers.

source_notes: Baker2020 p1-2: disk-integrated solar flux and approximate resolving power1e6, not disk-centre intensity.

Baker2020 p5-7 sections3.1.4/4.1/4.2: solar-template normalization and fitted continuum corrections are part of construction; final spectra combined after ephemeris/iodine/zero-point shifts. This does not prove the local offset cause.
Baker2020 p7-8: some telluric residual regions replaced with solar spline and flagged; exact zero O777 flags do not certify physical accuracy.
Reiners2016 p4 section5.2: normalized flux atlases have distinct normalization procedures; illustrative agreement elsewhere is not O777 calibration.
Historical RYA929 intake manifest describes absolute irradthu, not this residual irradrelwl; old unresolved medium/absolute units are not reassigned to the current residual file.
resolution_limit: Retained helper GaussianR500000 is numerical reference smoothing; approximate native R is not an independently calibrated FTS kernel. No deconvolution, new kernel or RV calibration.
